easyplace2.config.comment.easyPlace2Mode:
Separate Easy Place mode that only places blocks with normal vanilla clicks:
look at a missing schematic block and right click. The correct item is picked
automatically and a visible, reachable neighbor face is clicked.
No air place, no fake rotations, no special packets.
Independent from Litematica's old Easy Place (keep that one off).
easyplace2.config.comment.easyPlace2Dela:
Delay between two placements while holding right click, in game ticks
(20 ticks = 1 second). 4 is the vanilla speed, higher values are slower.
easyplace2.config.comment.easyPlace2Stri:
When enabled, only the face that your crosshair actually hits
(the block behind the ghost block) is clicked, exactly like a plain vanilla right click.
When disabled, any other neighbor face that is visible and in reach may be used.
easyplace2.config.comment.easyPlace2Debu: Shows in the action bar and the log why a block was skipped.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerToggleH: Starts or stops the printer without opening the menu.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerTurnSpe: How fast the camera turns to the next block (degrees per second).
easyplace2.config.comment.printerTurnJit: Varying speed and a slightly curved path so turning looks more natural.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerExtraDe: Up to this many ticks are randomly added to the placement delay.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerInvento: Shortest pause between inventory steps (open, swap item, close).
easyplace2.config.comment.printerReachMa: The printer stays this many blocks below the normal reach.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerUseBari:
When enabled, Baritone walks to blocks out of reach.
Baritone never builds or breaks anything itself.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerUseLaye: Only builds the layers Litematica currently renders (render layers).
easyplace2.config.comment.printerHud: Small status display in the top left while the printer runs.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerFastTur:
When enabled, the head snaps to the block within one frame and places on the next tick
(only up to the max angle, larger turns stay smooth).
When disabled, the camera turns smoothly. Either way the block orientation comes from the
look direction like in vanilla; if it does not fit, the printer walks to a matching side.
easyplace2.config.prettyName.printerFast: Printer: fast turn up to angle
easyplace2.config.comment.printerFastTur: Fast turn only if the view already points roughly that way (degrees).
easyplace2.config.comment.printerReactio: Minimum ticks the crosshair stays on the target before clicking.
Maximum ticks the crosshair stays on the target before clicking.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerPauseOn: When the player takes damage, the printer pauses for 3 seconds.
easyplace2.printer.title: Easy Place 2.0 Printer
easyplace2.printer.subtitle: Printer
easyplace2.printer.info.how1: The printer finds the missing blocks of all active Litematica placements and builds from the bottom up.
easyplace2.printer.info.how2: If a block is out of reach, Baritone walks there. Baritone never builds or breaks anything itself.
easyplace2.printer.info.how3: If the item is not in the hotbar, the inventory is opened like a player would, the item is moved to the hotbar with a number key and the inventory is closed again.
easyplace2.printer.info.how4: Then the camera turns to the neighbor face and a normal right click follows through Easy Place 2.0 with strict crosshair. Starting turns both on automatically.
easyplace2.printer.msg.started: Started. The printer waits while a menu is open.
easyplace2.printer.msg.no_schematic: No active schematic found. Load a placement in Litematica.
easyplace2.printer.msg.done: Done! %s of %s blocks match (%s wrong blocks were left alone).
